# knowledgesidekick.com

Business and technical education on why knowledge is the missing layer in agentic AI
and AI agents, and what disciplined knowledge representation, management, context
engineering, grounding, and encoding look like in practice.

## Sections

- Why Knowledge for Agentic AI — why knowledge matters for agents; the business and
  technical case. https://knowledgesidekick.com/why-knowledge.html
- Knowledge in Enterprise Context — collection and freshness challenges at
  organizational scale. https://knowledgesidekick.com/enterprise.html
- Knowledge in Personal Assistant Context — privacy, control, DPDP (India), GDPR (EU),
  and the personal-knowledge problem. https://knowledgesidekick.com/personal-assistant.html
- Context Engineering — context windows as a knowledge-delivery problem; patterns.
  https://knowledgesidekick.com/context-engineering.html
- Token Savings & Grounding — where token cost comes from; grounding claims in knowledge.
  https://knowledgesidekick.com/token-savings.html
- Home — the front door and table of contents. https://knowledgesidekick.com/
- Contact — email and links. https://knowledgesidekick.com/contact.html

## About

Author: Janardan Revuru. Background relevant to this topic: M.Tech in Data Science
(BITS Pilani, 2024); PhD in progress on multi-agent communication (expected around 2028);
three patents; AI Centre of Excellence built and scaled from zero to roughly 50 engineers
and 15 models; organizer of the Bengaluru JavaScript Meetup.

Full engineering portfolio: https://janalogy.com
